phase_0.boundary_condition: the sealed folding chamber that contains the polypeptide chain and all intermediate conformations

AFWD.chosen_element: chaperone binding to exposed hydrophobic residues
AFWD.justification: a directed transformation that moves the chain from an exposed state toward a protected intermediate

AREV.chosen_element: chaperone release from the folded protein
AREV.justification: a reverse descent transformation that returns the system from the bound intermediate to the free folded state

CLINK.chosen_element: sequential application of binding, folding, and release steps
CLINK.justification: composition of morphisms where the output of one folding operation becomes the input of the next

ENGAGR.justification: both states held at once as a live contradiction without resolution away

EVALF.justification: the negative arm where the protein adopts a non-functional misfolded conformation

EVALT.justification: the affirmative arm where the protein achieves its functional tertiary structure

FFUSE.justification: the productive and misfolded arms rejoin into a single resolved state held in the chamber boundary

FSPLIT.justification: one conformation opens into two arms: productive folding and misfolding

IFIX.justification: a permanent append-only record of the final conformation that cannot be undone

IMSCRIB.justification: self-reference where the folded protein is recognized as its own stable conformation

TANCH.justification: the terminal boundary that contains the entire folding protocol and its final conformation

VINIT.justification: the void state before any folding operation is named or applied

phase_2.rejoin_note: the productive arm applies chaperone-assisted folding while the misfolding arm records aggregation; the arms rejoin into one state, conflicting arms rejoin to B
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

steps.domain_action: unfolded polypeptide chain enters the chamber in an uninitialized state
chaperone binds exposed hydrophobic residues to protect the chain
binding step composes with the folding initiation step
the intermediate conformation splits into productive folding and misfolding arms
productive folding arm confirms the native tertiary structure
misfolding arm detects a non-functional aggregate conformation
native and misfolded states are held simultaneously as a live contradiction
chaperone releases the protein from the bound intermediate
the productive and misfolded arms rejoin into a single chamber exit state
the final conformation is recognized as its own stable structure
the folding log entry is permanently appended and sealed
the sealed folding chamber contains the completed protocol
